question: Give the code of sets have expansion commander type?
evidence: code of sets refers to setCode
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
gold: SELECT T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.type = 'commander'
gold0: SELECT T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.type = 'commander'

b.request: List the code of every set whose type is 'commander' (expansion commander type), including sets that have no matching record in set_translations (i.e., a left join from sets to set_translations, not dropping sets without translations)
b.sql: SELECT T1.code FROM sets AS T1 LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode WHERE T1.type = 'commander'

d.request: What are the set codes (setCode) of all sets whose expansion type is "commander", including sets that have no matching record in the set_translations table?
d.sql: SELECT s.code FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE s.type = 'commander'

c.request:
Give the code of sets have expansion commander type?
Evidence: code of sets refers to setCode
Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
c.sql: SELECT s.code, st.setCode FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.type = 'commander'
